study_note: One seed-57 AMBI Humanoid Run run matching the task-specific Q5 learner with ten critics. Use min over all critics for inner/outer targets and terminal bootstrap, mean over all critics for both actors, and no critic subset sampling. Preserve 1M decisions, sampled H3/J8/K1, N128/C16/A4/B256, fixed joint post-tanh entropy 0.0021, all 25k checkpoints and critic geometry every 1k outer updates.
